name: Sales Qualification Agent
headline: Make lead qualification consistent before outreach begins
pitch: Help sales managers and business-development teams review enrichment, ICP fit, BANT evidence, draft outreach, routing recommendations, and SLA plans from one governed workflow.
why_try: A team can see why a lead is prioritized, what qualification evidence is missing, and what should be reviewed next without triggering outreach or CRM automation.
customer_challenge: High lead volume makes manual qualification inconsistent, while incomplete context and uneven routing create avoidable follow-up risk.
microsoft_ai_story: Microsoft Copilot Studio gives sellers a qualification workspace. Dynamics 365 Sales supplies lead and ownership context, approved enrichment connectors contribute firmographic and intent evidence, and Microsoft Teams supports manager review of routing and SLA plans.
business_value: Makes qualification criteria and evidence easier to inspect.
Creates consistent draft outreach and routing recommendations.
Supports SLA planning while preserving seller and manager control.
business_flow: Business development rep, account executive, or sales manager

capabilities.name: Score Leads
capabilities.purpose: Applies the documented synthetic ICP and tiering model.

capabilities.name: Bant Analysis
capabilities.purpose: Breaks down budget, authority, need, and timeline evidence.

capabilities.name: Create Outreach
capabilities.purpose: Drafts reviewable outreach ideas without sending or scheduling them.

capabilities.name: Assign Leads
capabilities.purpose: Recommends routing from territory, specialty, and capacity assumptions.

capabilities.name: Setup Tracking
capabilities.purpose: Drafts SLA and escalation rules without activating alerts.

capabilities.name: Qualification Report
capabilities.purpose: Summarizes qualification evidence and review actions without conversion commitments.

Your team should start with the **8 Hot leads (score 80+)**, especially the top 3:

Scoring blends **35% ICP fit + 25% BANT + 40% intent data**, so these rose to the top because they combine the right company profile, real buying signals (budget/authority), and high recent engagement — not just firmographic match alone.

Below them: 15 Warm leads (60-79) worth an SDR call, and 22 Nurture leads better suited to an email sequence for now.
